cleared.why: the house on the Wapper and its garden: built by the level (rubens/fronts.js) as it may have stood about 1612
north side of the Grote Markt: the guild houses are built by the level as fronts

the site given for St Walburga's (nl.wikipedia: 'ter hoogte van de Zakstraat, ongeveer 50 m ten noorden van waar tegenwoordig het Steenplein ligt'): the church is built by the level; its exact footprint is not known
the round footprint on the Handschoenmarkt is the well ('de oude waterput van Quinten Matsijs', nl.wikipedia Handschoenmarkt), not a house: the level builds a well there

extra.why: houses on the vault over the Herentalse Vaart at the Meir end of the Wapper (nl.wikipedia Wapper: a row was built on the vaulting, the Geleyhuis of 1545 'tegen de Meir'; pulled down 1966-69). Footprints are the level's
the row of houses that parted the churchyard from the Schoenmarkt until about 1804 (INV th_983). Footprints are the level's; a gap is left where the errand passes

Het Steen was 'geheel ingebouwd' until the 1880s (INV er_4602); the photograph of 1880 shows its gate at the end of a narrow street. These footprints are the level's: which houses stood where is not known

canals.why: a rui dug in 1490 down the middle of what is now the Wapper; vaulting began in the first half of the 16th century and was complete only in 1819 (nl.wikipedia Wapper). Open here south of the houses on the vault; 4 m wide (nl.wikipedia Herentalse Vaart: 'nauwelijks vier meter breed')
a canal dug in 1489 between the Meirbrug and the Wapper, 'gedeeltelijk overwelfd' in 1541 (nl.wikipedia Meir). Which part lay open in 1612 is not known: the level leaves the eastern stretch open

an open rui with water down the middle until most of it was vaulted in 1661, the Boterrui end in 1832 (nl.wikipedia Suikerrui). Three bridges crossed it ('Loockbrugge', 'Potter- of Kordewagenkruiersbrug', 'IJzeren Brug', INV th_998): three plank bridges are shown, evenly spaced, their true places not found

rename_why.Groen Kerkhof: INV th_922: 'Groot Kerkhof', later 'Groen Kerkhof'; Blaeu 1649 'Kerck hoff'
rename_why.Vaartstraat: en.wikipedia Rubenshuis 'the then-Vaartstraat'; Blaeu legend '75. Vaert-straet' (not located on the plan): partly verified
rename_why.Kerckhofstrate: INV th_983: older names 'Tien Gebodenstrate', 'Kerckhofstrate', Schoenmarkt only after the French period; Blaeu 1649 '62. Kerchof-straet': partly verified

bank_why: Today's quay (OSM water edge) except by Het Steen, where the Werf is put back: 'de uitsprong aan de Werf (ter hoogte van het Steen)' was cut away in 1877-85 (INV th_14749); Blaeu 1649 'u. De Werff'. How far it ran out is not known: about 40 m here, the level's guess
